versions.content: The RTE shall call all Rte_Rips_NotifyCopyTxData Services from the Rte_LdComCbkCopyTxData callback for Communication Graphs where • The communication graph references an LdComIPdu which has its LdComIP- duDirection parameter set to LDCOM_SEND [SWS_LDCOM_00048] AND • for the related Communication Graph the RTE Implementation Plug-In support is enabled AND • a transformation is configured according to [SWS_Rte_08794].

The RTE shall call all Rte_Rips_NotifyCopyTxData Services from the Rte_LdComCbkCopyTxData callback for Communication Graphs where • The communication graph references an LdComIPdu which has its LdComIP- duDirection parameter set to LDCOM_SEND [SWS_LDCOM_00048] AND • for the related Communication Graph the RTE Implementation Plug-In support is enabled 866 of 1447 Document ID 84: AUTOSAR_SWS_RTE Specification of RTE Software AUTOSAR CP R22-11 AND • a transformation is configured according to [SWS_Rte_08794].

Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00312 The RTE shall call all Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyCopyTxData_<CGI> Services from the Rte_COMCbkCopyTxData callback for Communication Graphs where • The communication graph references a ComIPdu which has its ComIPduDirec- tion parameter set to COM_SEND [SWS_COM_00917] AND • for the related Communication Graph the RTE Implementation Plug-In support is enabled AND • a transformation is configured according to [SWS_Rte_08794].
